
Qwen3.6 35B-A3B on what-if: RX 7900 XT (20 GB VRAM), 64 GB RAM
Scenario: Claude Code — 20k-token system prompt + tools, then ~2.5k new tokens and ~300 output tokens per turn

RUNTIME                                  FILE            CONTEXT  MEMORY        FIRST REPLY  FOLLOW-UP  WRITES AT             TASK*
Ollama (defaults)                        Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  4k ⚠     ⚠ 21.5/20 GB  ?28 s        ?5.4 s     ?~98 tok/s at 22.6k   ?✗ breaks
Ollama (tuned)                           Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  56k      ⚠ 22.6/20 GB  ?29 s        ?8.3 s     ?~73 tok/s at 47.6k   ?5 min 40 s
llama.cpp (llama-server) (defaults)      Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  4k ⚠     ⚠ 21.5/20 GB  ?27 s        ?5.4 s     ?~100 tok/s at 22.6k  ?✗ breaks
llama.cpp (llama-server) (tuned)         Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  56k      ⚠ 22.6/20 GB  ?29 s        ?8.3 s     ?~79 tok/s at 47.6k   ?5 min 40 s
LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (defaults)  Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  4k ⚠     ⚠ 21.7/20 GB  ?28 s        ?5.5 s     ?~100 tok/s at 22.6k  ?✗ breaks
LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (tuned)     Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  56k      ⚠ 22.6/20 GB  ?30 s        ?8.4 s     ?~79 tok/s at 47.6k   ?5 min 43 s

FIRST REPLY = cold start (model load + the whole prompt). FOLLOW-UP = a typical later turn (new tokens only + the reply).
* TASK = a 40-call agent task; at datacenter speed it would take about 2 min 00 s. "✗ breaks" = the harness prompt does not fit the context.
Accuracy: no claim — model spills out of GPU memory: speed with CPU offload is not predictable (2–7× errors).

  ⚠ Ollama (defaults): Claude Code's ~20k-token prompt does not fit the 4096-token context (Ollama default for 20 GiB of GPU memory): the prompt is silently truncated and the agent will misbehave
  ⚠ Ollama (defaults): does not fit in GPU memory: layers spill to system RAM, typically 3–10× slower (not predictable)
  ⚠ quality caveat: the trial uses the cloud's provider-dependent weights; local Q4_K_M is typically 0–3 points worse on coding tasks and makes more tool-call mistakes
  ⚠ Ollama (tuned): does not fit in GPU memory: layers spill to system RAM, typically 3–10× slower (not predictable)
  ⚠ llama.cpp (llama-server) (defaults): Claude Code's ~20k-token prompt does not fit the 4096-token context (model native context, reduced to fit free memory): requests will be rejected with a context error
  ⚠ llama.cpp (llama-server) (defaults): does not fit in GPU memory: layers spill to system RAM, typically 3–10× slower (not predictable)
  ⚠ llama.cpp (llama-server) (tuned): does not fit in GPU memory: layers spill to system RAM, typically 3–10× slower (not predictable)
  ⚠ LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (defaults): Claude Code's ~20k-token prompt does not fit the 4096-token context (LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) default load setting): the middle of the conversation is silently cut
  ⚠ LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (defaults): does not fit in GPU memory: layers spill to system RAM, typically 3–10× slower (not predictable)
  ⚠ LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (tuned): does not fit in GPU memory: layers spill to system RAM, typically 3–10× slower (not predictable)

Recommendation: no runtime gives a working Claude Code setup for this model here — try a smaller quant (--quant), a smaller model, or --ctx.
